title: FEED RETURNS AFTER CANCELLED ABANDON
why: Closing the pause box left its abandon question armed. The left feed waited behind that hidden question until the pause box reopened.
now: Escape cancels the abandon question and the left feed resumes.

edits.replacement: disarmAbandon();   // v28.xx (cw-cx-abandonfeed): closing the pause box cancels its question too, so the left feed resumes after Escape.
